A list of all the ground units in the game. Ground Units are units that aren't capable of attacking Air Enemies, contrasting from Hybrid Units and Air/Hill Units. Ground Units usually have devastating amounts of damage and DPS, but aren't able to attack Air Units which is there one big drawback. Ground Units are currently the 2nd best tower type in the game in terms of damage, ground units are usually more capable of dishing out insane amounts of damage rather than Air/Hill Units.

Massive DPS, High SPA, Big Range, Full AoE and a Really Good Ability . Super Expensive to Max. Yamamoto gains one soul for each kill (souls received before upgrade 8 don't count). When you activate his ability, he starts a hybrid attack that hits several times and multiplies his base damage depending on the amount of souls received. The attack deals Yamamoto's base damage, plus 2% damage for every soul consumed in the attack. If he consumes 50 souls, that means he would do 200% damage (100% damage + (50 x 2%) = 200%). If he consumes 500 souls (max amount), that means he would do 1100% damage or 1,063,069.48 damage

Per-Unit (single) DPS is usually what most people in the community talk about as calculations are easier without taking into account number of placement. Please keep in mind that while certain characters' singular DPS may be higher than others, placement limits affect Total DPS significantly. The approximate range for DPS (PER SINGLE UNIT) descriptions are:

  • Bad DPS 1,000-2000
  • Moderate DPS 2,001-3,000
  • Good DPS 3,001-4000
  • High DPS 4,001-5,000
  • Great DPS 5,001-6,000
  • Amazing DPS 6,001-7,000
  • Massive DPS 7,001-8,000
  • Insane DPS 8,001-9,000
  • Colossal DPS 9,001-10,000
  • Ultimate DPS 10,001-25,000
  • Godly DPS 25,001-30,000+

DPS accounts for the DMG (Damage) of a unit divided by its SPA (Attack Speed). The Total damage of a unit can be higher or lower as some units can only be placed 3, 4, 5, etc. amount times.
